skills.skill: Recall division facts related to the 2, 5 and 10 times tables (to 100 ÷ 10)

misconceptions.pattern: Subtracts the divisor from the dividend instead of dividing (e.g. 24 ÷ 3 answered as 21 rather than 8), treating ÷ like -.

strategies.intent: Fair-share the dividend into the given number of equal groups (or ask how many groups of the divisor fit) — division undoes the matching multiplication fact.
